2e340351-7e43-449b-8de2-a590a34882b6.excerpt: One deep personal reflection about integrity, how human beings dey do two face, and the struggle to stand for principle inside world wey no send. E look the pain wey dey come when wetin person believe clash with the contradictions for society, and for the end e talk am clear say no be the hard times of life dey show who person really be, na wetin im don decide with open eye say im no go ever become.
2e340351-7e43-449b-8de2-a590a34882b6.full_text:
Reality Dey Hate Me?

By Alpha Amadu Jalloh

I don live reach to know say life fit turn against man without warning, without any reason, and without caring at all about wetin im don sacrifice so that im go fit still stand. I don see people dey rewrite truth make e fit wetin dem want, I don see how dem dey take loyalty as foolishness, and I don witness how easy e be for person dignity to turn something wey another person go just use for im own convenience. Wetin dey worry me no be say life hard. Na the bad realization say sometimes, the biggest punishment for being real person na say you go dey survive among people wey don master the art of pretending.

I never demand perfect world. I just dey ask why decency go dey struggle so tey before people recognize am, while wayo dey enjoy acceptance with comfort. How man go continue to believe for humanity when the same people wey dey talk about compassion fit no send at all about the suffering wey dem dey cause? Na there my argument with reality start.

I don see reach to understand say the world no dey always punish wrong or reward who do right. Sometimes, dem dey celebrate liars while dem dey interrogate people wey talk true. Sometimes, people wey dey destroy other people name dey sleep well well while the people wey dem wound dey stay awake for night, dey try recover their dignity. I don reach point where I must ask myself whether reality dey against me, or whether na just say I expect too much humanity from human beings.

Wetin dey disturb me no be only the disappointment wey I don meet, but how easy e be for people to drop their principles once their own interest dey under threat. I don learn say some people dey like honesty only when the truth no go expose dem. Dem dey praise loyalty until loyalty go demand sacrifice. Dem dey talk with passion about justice until justice go require make dem face somebody wey dem love or somebody wey dem dey chop from. Contradiction like this don force me to think again about wetin e mean to be human, and whether morality don turn something wey people dey advertise instead of to practice am.

I no dey claim say I perfect. I don make mistakes, I don judge situation wrong, I don trust where I suppose careful, and sometimes I don allow feeling enter where reason suppose dey. But I no gree accept say because person no perfect, e automatically mean say im no deserve respect, understanding or fairness. Something dey wey dey disturb person well well about society wey dey demand accountability from people wey no get power, while e dey manufacture excuse for people wey get power.

I don discover say one of the loneliest thing for life na when people wey don already decide wetin dem wan believe about you no understand you. You fit explain yourself again and again, show your intention with honesty, and still find out say some minds no dey find truth. Na confirmation for their prejudice dem dey find. For that kind time, silence go turn both hiding place and punishment, because to talk no dey change anything, while to keep quiet dey allow lie to grow.

But I no fit pretend say every hardship don make me strong. Some experience don tire me. Some disappointment don change how I dey trust. Some meeting don make me dey ask whether real compassion don dey turn rare human achievement instead of ordinary moral responsibility. I no dey shame to accept these things, because to admit say something don wound me no mean say I don surrender to am.

I dey fear more to become person wey no get feeling again than to admit say dem don wound me. Because wetin man go turn if im survive wickedness only to come do the same wickedness? Which victory dey for escaping injustice if the experience go turn am another tool for oppression? These questions matter to me because I no want make bitterness become who I be, no matter how many reasons life don give me to hold am close.

Maybe my biggest struggle na to accept say I no fit force the world to waka according to my conscience. I no fit demand make every person recognize say I sincere, and I no fit force situation to respect wetin I expect. But I fit decide wetin my experience go make me turn. I fit stand for principle without becoming mumu, get compassion without surrendering my dignity, and get courage without pretending say fear no dey.

So, when I ask, "Reality Dey Hate Me?" no be just say I dey vex. I dey face the painful distance between the world as e suppose be and the world as e really be.

I no need make reality favor me. I need the courage to face am without betraying myself. And if my life must continue to be one argument wey no get end between suffering and conviction, I don make up my mind say nobody go ever silence that conviction.

Because I no be only wetin life don do me.

I be also wetin I don decide with open eye say I no go ever become.
